title: feat(P1): Spec Protocol Alignment — UI-Facing
body:
Completes P1 from ROADMAP.md — aligns all view plugins, page composition, and record components with `@objectstack/spec` v3.0.8 contracts. Adds 67 tests across types and bridge layers.

### P1.1 ListView
- `ListViewSchema`: `rowActions`, `bulkActions`, `virtualScroll`, `userActions`, `appearance`, `tabs`, `addRecord`, `showRecordCount`, `allowPrinting`
- `ObjectGridSchema`: spec-shaped `conditionalFormatting` (expression + style map), `emptyState`, `virtualScroll`, `rowSpecActions`/`bulkSpecActions`
- Bridge passes all new properties through to SchemaNode

### P1.2 FormView
- Bridge maps spec `type` → `formType` (`tabbed`/`wizard`/`split`/`drawer`/`modal`)
- `FormSection.columns` (1–4) and `FormField` props (`widget`, `dependsOn`, `visibleOn`, `colSpan`) already wired — bridge now forwards them

### P1.3 Dashboard
- `DashboardWidgetSchema`: data binding (`object`/`filter`/`categoryField`/`valueField`/`aggregate`), `colorVariant` (8 variants), `measures` for pivot/matrix, `aria`
- `DashboardSchema`: `header` with actions, `globalFilters` with `optionsFrom`, `dateRange` (14 presets + custom)
- Bridge emits `date-range-filter` node and structured `filter-bar` with per-filter metadata

### P1.4 Page Composition
- `PageType`: 4 → 16 (`dashboard`, `grid`, `list`, `gallery`, `kanban`, `calendar`, `timeline`, `form`, `record_detail`, `record_review`, `overview`, `blank`)
- `PageVariable.type` gains `record_id`; new `source` field
- `PageSchema.blankLayout` for free-form grid canvas
- Bridge forwards `blankLayout`, region `width`, `description`, `icon`, `aria`

### P1.5 Record Components
New `record-components.ts` with spec-aligned prop interfaces:

```typescript
import type {
  RecordDetailsComponentProps,
  RecordHighlightsComponentProps,
  RecordRelatedListComponentProps,
  RecordActivityComponentProps,
  RecordChatterComponentProps,
  RecordPathComponentProps,
} from '@object-ui/types';
```

### P1.6 i18n & ARIA
- Re-export `I18nLabel`, `AriaProps`, and all spec Dashboard/Form/ListView/Page/Record types from `@objectstack/spec/ui` (prefixed `Spec*` to avoid collisions)
- ARIA props added to `DashboardSchema`, `DashboardWidgetSchema`, `PageSchema`
- All four bridges pass `aria` through

### Tests
- 31 type-level tests (`p1-spec-alignment.test.ts`)
- 36 bridge tests (`P1SpecBridge.test.ts`)
- Full suite: 282 files, 4952 tests, 0 regressions
